item.title: Defeated Brazilian candidate Flavio Bolsonaro's passports cancelled, whereabouts unknown
item.description: Brazil on Tuesday cancelled ​Senator Flavio Bolsonaro's passports after he failed to hand them into police as part of a money laundering probe in which he denies wrongdoing. The whereabouts of the former presidential candidate – who on Sunday lost to leftist incumbent President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva – are currently unknown, stoking suspicions he has fled the country. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro rumoured to have fled Brazil after presidential election loss
item.description: Authorities demanded he hand over his passport after loss to Lula but far-right senator remains unaccounted for The far-right senator Flávio Bolsonaro has not been seen since Monday and missed a Tuesday-morning deadline to hand his passport to the federal police, fuelling rumours that he may have fled Brazil after losing Sunday’s presidential election. A supreme court justice cancelled Bolsonaro’s passport minutes after the result in a ruling related to a criminal case against the senator. He until 11am to surrender the document to the federal police, but did not appear. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: "Lo que Netanyahu podría hacer después de las elecciones es el verdadero peligro": 'Haaretz'
item.description: Las elecciones de Israel tienen a Benjamin Netanyahu y la guerra en el centro del debate. Medios israelíes hablan de los escenarios para el país, luego de estas votaciones. 'Haaretz' dice que intenta aferrarse, con uñas y dientes, al poder. Además, menciona que, si pierde, intentará provocar otra guerra y es la oposición la que debe formar un gobierno a la velocidad del rayo. 'Ynet' explica que lograr ese objetivo podría tardar semanas y beneficiaría a Netanyahu, quien buscaría obstaculizar cualquier coalición opositora. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.description: El senador brasileño Flávio Bolsonaro, derrotado en las elecciones presidenciales del domingo frente a Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, no entregó sus pasaportes a la Policía Federal dentro del plazo fijado por el Supremo Tribunal Federal. Los documentos fueron cancelados y el paradero del legislador, investigado en una causa por presunto lavado de dinero, era desconocido este martes. El excandidato niega haber cometido irregularidades. Publicado también por: France 24 - Español. Fuente: France 24 Español.

item.title: US charges 48 non-citizens in election-related cases across five states; two Indians named
item.description: The US Justice Department has announced charges against 48 non-citizens in election-related cases across Pennsylvania, California, Florida, New York and Nevada. Two Indian nationals are among those accused. The cases involve allegations of illegal voting in federal elections, fraudulent voter registration and false claims of US citizenship, including alleged misrepresentations in naturalisation proceedings. All defendants are presumed innocent. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
